translations.web: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.
translations.bsb: Lambs will graze as in their own pastures, and strangers will feed in the ruins of the wealthy.
translations.kjv: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
translations.asv: Then shall the lambs feed as in their pasture, and the waste places of the fat ones shall wanderers eat.
